title: Activating a part activates its core, and a core cannot be activated on its own
custom_preconds: Admin. Inactive part P with a core part (core id known from DevTools).
custom_steps:
1. Inactive tab → Activate parts → tick P → note "core check" → Activate
  2. Open /parts/history/{core id}
  3. Replay PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<core id>"],"status":"active"}
custom_expected:
1. P is active; the toast counts only P
  2. The core has its own "Activated | Reason: core check" entry
  3. 200 with the core in failed: "A core follows its part. Activate or deactivate the part instead."
